summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 1,890,627 restricted share units (RSUs) to employees under its Second Amended and Restated 2018 Share Incentive Plan. Each RSU represents one Class Z ordinary share, with a nil purchase price and a market price of HK$124.70 per share on the grant date. The RSUs vest between June 2027 and June 2030 with no performance targets but subject to clawback. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
